title: The Base Falls
setup: An Advance French: White has put the bishop on d3 and the knight on c3, and nobody has counted the pawn at the base of the chain.
hint: Count the attackers and defenders of White's base pawn. The bishop on d3 is standing in front of one of White's defenders.
explanation:
## The Idea

The base of White's chain is d4. Your knight on c6 and queen on b6 attack it, and only the knight on f3 defends it: the bishop on d3 blocks the white queen's road.

{{Nxd4}} takes it, and after {{Nxd4}} {{Qxd4}} you are a clean pawn up. The usual trick, a bishop check on b5 that uncovers White's queen, fails here because your bishop on d7 covers b5 once the knight has left c6.

Count the base of the chain first.
